name: Bill Helmsing
profile: UT Austin alumnus and one of the 2016 co-founders of Apptronik (with Jeff Cardenas, Nick Paine, Luis Sentis and Gen. Bill Welch), the humanoid-robot spin-out of UT's Human Centered Robotics Lab now valued ~$5B. Little else about him is public.
interesting_fact: Apptronik, which he co-founded, ran without outside investors through at least 2018, building its own actuators and controllers in-house for clients including NASA and Lockheed Martin.
notes: Very low public profile; not quoted in Apptronik press. Web search budget exhausted before a fuller check.

name: Blake Byers
current_role: Co-founder & board member, NewLimit; independent investor
profile: Stanford bioengineering PhD who spent a decade as a partner at GV (seed in Robinhood, Series A in IonQ, Grail, Forty Seven, Denali, Arcus). In 2022 he co-founded NewLimit with Brian Armstrong and Jacob Kimmel to extend healthspan via epigenetic reprogramming (~$2B valuation); he also invests personally in OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Neuralink, SpaceX and Harmonic.
interesting_fact: At GV he invested in 38 companies: 10 went public, 7 were acquired, 17 still active, 4 shut down - and he helped scale the firm from a $50M fund to a $2.5B fund.
deep_cut_fact: He has run research experiments since high school and kept doing so even while at Google Ventures; his published papers include work on rudimentary bio-hybrid brain-computer interfaces and induced pluripotent stem cells.
notes: His site invites contact ('Please reach out'). Calls NewLimit's mission 'Give everyone +20 years of healthy life'. Good fit for a science/frontier-tech conversation.

name: Yoshi Yokokawa
current_role: Co-founder & CEO, Alpaca (brokerage-infrastructure API, self-clearing broker-dealer)
profile: Japanese founder who began at Lehman Brothers' securitization team in 2004, then day-traded full-time and co-founded software businesses before starting Alpaca with Hitoshi Harada. Alpaca provides APIs for stocks, ETFs, options and crypto to apps worldwide, has raised ~$320M (incl. a $150M Series D in Jan 2026) and has 250+ staff in 25 countries.
interesting_fact: He was selected as an Endeavor Entrepreneur; Alpaca is fully remote across 25 countries.
deep_cut_fact: The name 'Alpaca' came from a drive around Woodside to see Masayoshi Son's under-construction $100M house, where he and Harada spotted dozens of pet alpacas next door; they also liked that it starts with 'a' in both English and Japanese (あ).
notes: Active on LinkedIn/X and podcasts - accessible.

name: Viswa Colluru
current_role: Founder & CEO, Enveda (AI-enabled drug discovery from natural compounds)
profile: PhD scientist who was the first Innovation Scientist and Product Manager at Recursion before founding Enveda in 2019. Enveda maps nature's chemistry to find new medicines; it became a clinical-stage unicorn with a $150M Series D (Sept 2025) and raised $311M more in Sept 2026.
interesting_fact: The name Enveda blends 'enable' with the Sanskrit 'veda' (knowledge); the company has an office in Genome Valley, Hyderabad.
deep_cut_fact: He started Enveda with $55k of his personal savings; his company bio quotes Kipling's 'If' and notes he plays racquet sports and reads several books at once.
notes: Named UBS Global Visionary (2023); member of WEF Unicorn Innovator Community. No published press email found.
